fields.Name: Sales: Confirmed Orders Missing Agreement
fields.UserQuestion: Which confirmed orders have no deal, no contract, or no executed contract, so should not be invoiced yet?
fields.Description: Confirmed orders that have no deal, no contract, no signed date on the contract, or no file in the Executed Agreement category. Web orders, returns and subscription auto-renewals are left out, and Payment Link orders are checked for a deal only.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: OrderHeader, one row per failing order (golive #388). Confirmed is Status = 'Confirmed'. Excludes checkout orders (SourceCheckoutWidgetID set) reversals (ReversesOrderHeaderID set, or OrderType Return or Cancellation) and subscription auto-renewals (any OrderLine with RenewsSubscriptionID). The deal is the vwDeals row with OrderID = the order, Won (DealStatusType.IsWon) first, then newest, then ID; the contract is that deal's COALESCE(ContractID, RenewsContractID), so a won renewal deal is checked against the contract it renews. Payment Link is ContractType.RequiresExecutedDocument = 0, never a name: those orders read HasContract, HasSignedDate and HasExecutedDocument = 1. HasSignedDate is Contract.ExecutedDate IS NOT NULL; HasExecutedDocument is vwContracts.IsAwaitingDocument = 0 (a file in the 'Executed Agreement' FileCategory). A check that cannot run because an earlier one failed reads 0. Date dimension: ConfirmedAt, for ordering only. Optional parameters: CompanyID (single) and CompanyIDs (array, sqlIn).
